sentences.en: The field of aeronautics involves designing and building airplanes.
sentences.zh: 航空学涉及飞机的设计和制造。

sentences.en: She studied aeronautics in college to become an aerospace engineer.
sentences.zh: 她在大学里学习了航空学，以便成为一名航空航天工程师。

sentences.en: The museum has exhibits on the history of aeronautics and aviation.
sentences.zh: 博物馆有关于航空学和航空历史的展品。
